recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to individual connection-type codes should generally be handled through THO/UTG or the owning external vocabulary such as IHE mCSD, while core should continue to bind Endpoint.connectionType to the example endpoint-connection-type ValueSet unless PA makes a later contrary decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11250 asked PA to update Endpoint.connectionType's definition and value set from subscription-channel-like wording to the higher-level protocol/profile/standard used by the endpoint connection, with DICOM, IHE, and Direct examples. Jira status is Published with resolution Persuasive.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly names FHIR-11250. The apparent initial application is commit 3e7c097adea104fa3f766d892afffaaf65f6f0db, which changed Endpoint.connectionType to endpoint-contype, added the Protocol/Profile/Standard short label and technical-details definition, and introduced an Endpoint connection-type terminology set with IHE, DICOM, FHIR, HL7v2, and secure-email codes. Later FHIR-12364 added direct-project and a Direct Endpoint example.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source keeps Endpoint.connectionType as 1..* CodeableConcept with an example binding to ValueSet/endpoint-connection-type, and that ValueSet composes from THO CodeSystem/endpoint-connection-type. Later already-audited Endpoint issues explain the current shape: FHIR-12342/FHIR-34261 made connectionType repeatable, FHIR-36589 changed it to CodeableConcept/example binding and added IHE mCSD context, FHIR-12364 added direct-project, FHIR-17593 added cds-hooks-service through THO/UTG, and FHIR-36327 declined making connectionType optional.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active Endpoint source and THO-backed value set already convey the requested concept after considering later related decisions.
